name: Re-Laive
source:
Main character gets to the same class as his childhood friend Kazue in the new school year. By a twist of fate they even get to share the same dormitory room. One day she confesses to protagonist, but he only sees a childhood friend in her. This year is going to be unlike any other.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
新學年，主角與青梅竹馬佐伯梢分到同一班。陰錯陽差之下，兩人甚至住進了同一間宿舍。一天，梢向主角告白，但主角只把她當作青梅竹馬。這個學年將與以往截然不同。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
